title: Cinderhold: the first raid
text:
Beneath the Cinder Caldera, the gate of Cinderhold stands open. Seven bosses, the Ember Tyrant, a legendary weapon for every class and a mount wreathed in flame. Only heroes of level 20 may enter.

✨ Cinderhold, Emberfall's first raid, for 5 to 8 heroes at level 20. You need a Bulwark, a Mender, a Bard and damage. Find Emberwarden Thalia at the Cinderhold Gate, east of the Wyrm's Lair
✨ Seven fights: Kragmor the Forgewarden, Ignara and Pyrrus the Twin Flames, Ashmaw, Magmaroth, High Pyromancer Sel'vara, Gravoth the Obsidian Colossus and Vyrathos, the Ember Tyrant
✨ Loot gets better with every boss. Tyrant's Embers from every boss (and from daily bounties at level 20) buy Cinderhold epics from Quartermaster Brannoc
✨ The Ember Tyrant can drop a Tyrant legendary weapon for your class (2.5%) and the Ashborn Nightmare mount (1.5%). First kill earns the title Tyrantslayer
✨ Pyraxis, Herald of the Tyrant, is now a towering fire phoenix with burning wings and a tail of ember plumes
✨ A new quest, The Gate Below, leads from the end of the Scorched Reach to the raid gate, and reaching level 20 points you straight at Cinderhold
